Professional Summary

I am a marketing strategist, creative content specialist and business development professional with proven experience in building growth strategies, managing cross-functional teams, and driving performance-led initiatives.

My strength lies in aligning communication, marketing, and business objectives to support sustainable growth. I have led campaigns across Malaysia and Singapore, blending creative direction with hard data analytics to deliver ROI. Today I also build websites and applications, bringing the same commercial thinking into the product itself.
